en: Colorized historic postcard showing a street scene with pedestrians and a tall cypress tree in the foreground. On the right side stands a large church building that has a prominent white minaret, indicating its former or mixed religious use. Low-rise houses line both sides of the street. At the top left, bilingual French and English captions identify the location as the Church of St. Demetre in Salonique/Saloniga.
